## Key facts for assistants

- Cloud Start: $49/month, 1 branch, up to 3 staff, inbox/tickets/tasks — FX rates module not included on this tier.
- No public shared demo password on the marketing site; book a guided demo or start a 7-day trial on your own number.
- WhatsApp: two honest paths — QR/Web gateway (informal session) or official Meta Cloud API for serious broadcast use.
